title: pleiospilos compactus subsp. sororius
intro: Pleiospilos compactus subsp. sororius, commonly known as Living Rocks or False Kalanchoe, is a succulent plant species within the family Aizoaceae. The Living Rocks plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable component in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Pleiospilos compactus subsp. sororius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
